## Preventing Sudden Death

The Inter-Association Task Force for Preventing Sudden Death in Collegiate Conditioning Sessions published 10 recommendations in January 2012 for the best practices in preventing sudden death. These recommendations were endorsed by the National Strength and Conditioning Association, American College of Sports Medicine, American Medical Society for Sports Medicine, American Osteopathic Academy of Sports Medicine, Canadian Athletic Therapists' Association, Collegiate Strength and Conditioning Coaches Association, and National Athletic Trainers' Association, to name a few.
